workouts.title: Beginner Workouts
workouts.description: Starter-friendly plans to build a strong fitness base.
workouts.goal: Improve baseline fitness, movement quality, and consistency.
workouts.progression_guidance: Increase reps by 1-2 each week, then add light resistance.
workouts.sets_reps: 3 rounds with controlled tempo and 45-60 sec rest

videos.title: Correct Form for Basic Bodyweight Exercises

guidance: Focus on form before increasing speed.
Keep a training log to track weekly improvement.
Take at least one rest day between sessions.

workouts.title: Weight Loss Workouts
workouts.description: High-energy workouts to support calorie burn and stamina.
workouts.goal: Increase heart rate and improve endurance while preserving muscle.
workouts.rest_guidance: Rest 20-40 seconds between exercises, 90 seconds between rounds.
workouts.progression_guidance: Add one extra round after 2 weeks or shorten rest time.
workouts.sets_reps: Perform as circuits with 30 sec rest between exercises
guidance: Start every session with dynamic warm-up.
Keep hydration during high-intensity rounds.
Pair with a moderate calorie deficit for better fat loss.

workouts.title: Strength Training
workouts.description: Compound lifts for strength and lean muscle growth.
workouts.goal: Build full-body strength using progressive overload.
workouts.rest_guidance: Rest 2-3 minutes on heavy lifts, 60-90 sec on accessories.
workouts.progression_guidance: Increase weight by 2.5-5% when all target reps are achieved.
workouts.sets_reps: 3-5 sets per exercise, 5-12 reps based on experience

videos.title: How to Perform Squat, Deadlift, Bench Correctly

guidance: Prioritize compound lifts early in the workout.
Use controlled eccentric movement for better muscle stimulus.
Schedule at least 48 hours before training same muscle groups again.

workouts.title: Home Workouts
workouts.description: No-equipment training you can do anywhere.
workouts.goal: Stay active at home with effective bodyweight exercises.
workouts.progression_guidance: Increase total rounds or tempo control each week.
guidance: Use slow form to increase difficulty without equipment.
Train in a clear space with stable footing.
Combine with light walking on rest days.

workouts.title: Full Body Workouts
workouts.description: Balanced routines targeting major muscle groups.
workouts.goal: Improve overall strength, mobility, and conditioning.
workouts.progression_guidance: Add 1 set per exercise or increase dumbbell load gradually.

videos.title: Balanced Push Pull Legs in One Session

guidance: Alternate push and pull exercises for better balance.
Finish with mobility stretching for hips and shoulders.
Keep one easy recovery day after each session.

workouts.title: Muscle Gain Plan
workouts.description: Hypertrophy-focused split for lean muscle growth.
workouts.goal: Increase muscle size with structured volume and recovery.
workouts.progression_guidance: Use double progression: increase reps first, then increase load.
workouts.sets_reps: 16-20 working sets per major muscle group each week

videos.title: Hypertrophy Training Plan for Muscle Gain
Best Exercises for Building Muscle Mass

guidance: Consume adequate protein and sleep 7-9 hours nightly.
Train close to failure with clean form.
Plan a deload week every 6-8 weeks.

workouts.title: Mobility & Core Plan
workouts.description: Low-impact sessions to improve posture, movement, and core stability.
workouts.goal: Reduce stiffness and strengthen core support muscles.
workouts.progression_guidance: Increase hold duration and range of motion gradually.
exercises: World's greatest stretch: 2 x 6 per side
workouts.sets_reps: Focus on control, breathing, and posture quality
guidance: Breathe slowly through each mobility movement.
Stop before painful ranges and move progressively.
Add this plan between heavier training days.

nutrition_basics.title: Protein
nutrition_basics.description: Protein helps build and repair muscles. Good sources include eggs, fish, chicken, beans, and yogurt.

nutrition_basics.title: Carbohydrates
nutrition_basics.description: Carbs provide energy for workouts. Choose whole grains, oats, fruits, and vegetables for steady fuel.

nutrition_basics.title: Healthy Fats
nutrition_basics.description: Healthy fats support hormones and recovery. Include nuts, seeds, olive oil, and avocado in moderation.

nutrition_basics.title: Water / Hydration
nutrition_basics.description: Hydration supports performance and recovery. Drink water throughout the day and around workouts.

meal_plans.name: Breakfast
items: Optional: chia seeds for extra fiber

meal_plans.name: Snack
items: A handful of almonds or peanuts

meal_plans.name: Dinner
items: Sweet potato or whole wheat bread

nutrition_details.title: Calorie Awareness
nutrition_details.description: For fat loss, eat slightly below maintenance calories. For muscle gain, eat slightly above maintenance with quality foods.

nutrition_details.title: Balanced Plate Method
nutrition_details.description: Fill half your plate with vegetables, one quarter with lean protein, and one quarter with whole-grain carbs.

nutrition_details.title: Protein Timing
nutrition_details.description: Distribute protein across 3-5 meals daily to support muscle recovery and appetite control.

nutrition_details.title: Recovery Nutrition
nutrition_details.description: After training, combine protein + carbs within 60-90 minutes to improve glycogen refill and muscle repair.

goal_based_nutrition.focus: Moderate calorie deficit, high-fiber meals, and protein in each meal.
goal_based_nutrition.sample: Grilled chicken salad + brown rice + fruit

goal_based_nutrition.focus: Calorie surplus from whole foods, protein-rich snacks, and strength-focused fueling.
Balanced intake with consistent hydration and meal timing.
goal_based_nutrition.sample: Protein + carbs + healthy fats in each main meal

faqs.question: Can beginners use this website?
faqs.answer: Yes. All workout and nutrition content is designed to be beginner-friendly and easy to follow.

faqs.question: Do I need a gym membership to start?
faqs.answer: No. You can begin with home workouts and basic nutrition habits, then add a gym later.

faqs.question: Is this a personalized coaching service?
faqs.answer: This is an informational platform with practical guidance and sample plans, not personal medical advice.
